front.title: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI
front.tldr: Shopify's new Canvas tool lets merchants build and customise online stores by chatting with its AI agent Sidekick, watching changes happen live. A real test of how far conversational building can go.

front.title: The new Kindle ditches the bezel for a smaller, lighter design
front.tldr: Amazon's new Kindle lineup is its lightest and thinnest yet, with a front-flush display that drops the raised bezel entirely. A small, deliberate redesign rather than a spec-sheet exercise.

front.title: Ben Affleck explains his approach to using AI ethically on new movie 'Animals'
front.tldr: Affleck says he used AI on the Netflix film but would not use anything trained on copyrighted work or the work of a peer. A working line for the craft debate rather than a blanket stance.

stories.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you
stories.tldr: OpenAI is rolling out shopping features that let ChatGPT users try on clothes and accessories using their own photos and save favourites. Moves the assistant further into everyday retail.

stories.title: Brian Chesky interview: AI agents need their own operating system
stories.tldr: Chesky talks about making Airbnb agent-friendly and why he thinks consumer AI needs a native operating system, not just apps bolted onto old interfaces.

stories.title: Hearing tech startup Legato launches its AI hearing glasses
stories.tldr: Legato's new AI hearing glasses aim to make hearing care more accessible by addressing the cost, comfort and stigma of traditional hearing aids.

stories.title: Photon held a funeral for mobile apps. Now it has $4.5M to help replace them with agents
stories.tldr: The startup helps developers build AI agents that work over iMessage, SMS and email, betting that people will use agents instead of downloading apps.

stories.title: World's first enhanced geothermal power plant completed in just 23 months
stories.tldr: Fervo Energy finished its first enhanced geothermal plant in under two years, with later phases expected to connect to the grid even faster.

stories.title: NYC's click-to-cancel rule is now in effect
stories.tldr: New York's new rule requires subscriptions to be as easy to cancel as they are to start. A small, practical consumer win.

stories.title: Metro 2033 and Metro: Last Light remasters are getting free next-gen updates
stories.tldr: The first two Metro games are getting free next-gen updates this month, a no-cost refresh for an older pair of favourites.

stories.title: Samsung launches its first clip-on earbuds in South Korea
stories.tldr: Samsung's first clip-on earbuds are launching in South Korea, with a global rollout to follow, though details are still unconfirmed.

stories.title: Apple commissions photographers for new 'Shot on iPhone Duo' campaign
stories.tldr: Apple's Instagram account published a carousel of photos commissioned from Jake Michaels and Jason Nocito to showcase the iPhone Duo's cameras, its latest marketing push for the device.

stories.title: Audible announces AI-powered character guides, interactive stories, more
stories.tldr: Audible unveiled three new features meant to deepen listeners' connection to their favourite audiobooks, including AI character guides.

stories.title: Apple TV's acclaimed 'The Last First: Winter K2' documentary now streaming
stories.tldr: The extreme mountain climbing documentary has a 100% Rotten Tomatoes score and is now available to Apple TV subscribers.

stories.title: iPhone 18 Pro aperture control goes fully manual in Halide 3.2
stories.tldr: The award-winning Halide camera app has been updated to version 3.2, adding dedicated support for broadening manual control over the iPhone 18 Pro's variable aperture camera.

stories.title: Monster Mash: legendary special-effects makeup creator Rick Baker on making decades of movie magic
stories.tldr: Rick Baker talks through his career in special-effects makeup, from building Bigfoot for Harry and the Hendersons to his work with Eddie Murphy on Coming to America.

stories.title: 10 animators to watch on AI, animation's future and why the human hand still matters
stories.tldr: At SCAD AnimationFest, ten animators and an Oscar-nominated director discussed AI's role in animation and why the human hand still matters to the craft.

stories.title: Talia Ryder joins Tom Holland in Fred Astaire biopic
stories.tldr: Margaret Qualley and Sabrina Carpenter are also set to star in the Sony project from director Paul King, about the life of dancer Fred Astaire.

stories.title: Bradley Cooper to star in new G.I. Joe movie for Paramount
stories.tldr: Danny McBride is directing the live-action film and co-wrote the script, with Bradley Cooper set to star.

stories.title: Jayson Tatum shares promising recovery update at Celtics practice
stories.tldr: Sixteen and a half months after rupturing his Achilles, Tatum gave an encouraging update on his recovery at Celtics practice.

stories.title: The reasons behind Alonso renewing his F1 contract with Aston Martin
stories.tldr: Fernando Alonso has signed on for another year at Aston Martin for 2027, a decision the team says has been on the cards for some time.

stories.title: Audi reveals plans for new F1 team base
stories.tldr: Audi is developing a new Formula 1 campus close to Sauber's long-standing Swiss headquarters, as the manufacturer builds out its F1 operation.

stories.title: The family behind one of F1's greatest archives
stories.tldr: For almost 70 years, Bernard and Paul-Henri Cahier have captured every aspect of Formula 1 on camera, building one of the sport's great photographic records.

finally.tldr: A map from mapped.earth plots every lighthouse on the planet, along with lighted buoys and other charted lights, with the lights on the live version moving in real time.
